description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget named ItemDetailScreen, which represents a screen displaying detailed information about a menu item in a restaurant app. It includes UI elements to show item image, description, ingredients, allergens, nutrition info, and options to customize the item such as portion selection, spice level, and quantity, along with an 'Add to Cart' button.
